items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: Yeah Barney Bigard, yeah... And drums was Stan Levy?... the pianist didn’t show up so Leonard Feather had to play piano. And it was Georgie Auld on tenor... clarinet was — Barney Bigard?

ctx.x: Yeah Barney Bigard, yeah, help me.
